entries.source: A Halfling slinger. He seems adept at combat.
entries.target: 一位半身人投石者，他似乎很擅长战斗。

entries.source:
Faeros are highly intelligent fire elementals, rarely seen outside volcanoes. They are probably not native to this world.
This one looks even nastier and looks toward you with what seems to be disdain. Flames swirl all around him.
entries.target:
法罗是高智慧的火焰元素，在火山以外的其他地方很少看到。它们很可能不属于这个世界。
这只看起来更加凶残，它用蔑视的眼神看着你。火焰在它的身上流转。

entries.source: This huge mass of deformed flesh was probably once an ogre, but something had gone wrong.
entries.target: 这团巨大的畸形血肉很可能曾经是一个食人魔，但出了什么差错。

entries.source: This ogre seems to have tried to graft golem parts on its own body. To various interresting results.
entries.target: 这个食人魔似乎试图把傀儡的部件嫁接在自己身上。结果多种多样，颇为有趣。

entries.source: This greatsword-wielding ogre looks at you with contempt and hatred.
entries.target: 这个挥舞着大剑的食人魔用带着鄙视和仇恨的眼神凝视着你。
孔克雷夫治疗师亚斯特莉

entries.source: An enormous ogre, clad in a tattered set of robes with an officer's badge.  She clutches a healer's staff, wrapped in casting plaster and scalpels for use as a massive spiked club.
entries.target: 一个巨大的食人魔，身穿一件别着官员徽章的破烂长袍。她紧握一把治疗用的法杖，法杖上裹满了铸型石膏和手术刀，被当作一根巨大的狼牙棒使用。
治疗师亚斯特莉的日志

entries.source: A very faded note, nearly unreadable.
entries.target: 极度磨损的笔记，几乎无法阅读。
治疗师亚斯特莉的“狼牙棒”

entries.source: Like its former owner, this was once an instrument of altruistic healing, before fury and fear caused its twisting into a sadistic weapon.  Surges of restorative magic can be faintly felt under the layers of plaster and sharp surgical equipment.
entries.target: 如同它的前任主人一样，这曾经是无私治愈的工具，然而愤怒和恐惧将其扭曲成一把嗜血的武器。在层层石膏与锋利的手术器械之下，依稀能感觉到治疗魔法的涌动。

entries.source: Improves the contribution of primary stats on infusions and runes by 15%
entries.target: 增加符文和纹身的属性加成效果15%
古老的孔克雷夫地下实验室

entries.source: This huge demon is covered in darkness. The ripped flesh of its "mother" still hangs from its sharp claws.
entries.target: 这只巨大的恶魔被黑暗所包围。它的“母亲”的碎肉仍悬挂在它的利爪上。

entries.source: and devoured as a demonic breakfast
entries.target: 并将其当作恶魔早餐吞噬

entries.source: A female Human with twisted sigils scored into her naked flesh. Her wrists and ankles are sore and hurt by ropes and chains. You can discern great beauty beyond the stains of blood covering her skin.
entries.target: 一位赤裸并且全身刻有扭曲符文的女人。她的四肢被镣铐绑在了祭台上。尽管她的皮肤上满是鲜血，你仍然能发现她的美丽。

entries.source: Acolyte of the Sect of Kryl-Feijan
Black-robed Elves with a mad look in their eyes.
entries.target: 穿着黑色长袍的精灵，他们的眼中满是疯狂。

entries.source:
The woman seems to be freed from her bonds.
She stumbles on her feet, her naked body still dripping in blood. 'Please get me out of here!'
entries.target:
这个女人从镣铐束缚中解脱了。
她蹒跚着向你走来，鲜血从她赤裸的皮肤上滴落。“请带我离开这里！”

entries.source: Whispers seem to ceaselessly emanate from this writhing mass of black tentacles, murmuring unspeakable horrors into the ears of any unfortunate enough to hear them.
entries.target: 从这团扭动的黑色触须中似乎不停地传出耳语，向任何不幸听到的人诉说着难以言喻的恐怖。

entries.source: You hear an eerie chanting echoing from a distance.
entries.target: 你听到远方传来的念诵回响声。

entries.source: The chanting grows louder. You hear a sudden high-pitched scream.
entries.target: 念诵声增大了。你突然听到一声尖叫。

entries.source: The cultists are about to sacrifice the woman. Stop them!
entries.target: 邪教徒准备献祭那个女人。阻止他们！

entries.source: The woman lets out a sudden ear-splitting scream that turns from pain to horror as her stomach is ripped open from within by long dark claws. A towering black demon arises, rending her flesh to shreds, and replacing her dying scream with a terrifying roar.
entries.target: 这个女人突然发出一声震耳欲聋的尖叫，叫声由痛苦转为惊恐——修长的黑色利爪从内部撕开了她的腹部。一个铁塔般的黑色恶魔站了起来，将她的血肉撕成碎片，她临终的惨叫被一声骇人的咆哮取代。

entries.source: Are you sure you want to enter? There's no telling where you will end up or if you will be able to make it back.
entries.target: 你确定要进去么？没人知道这会把你带到哪里，你也无法知道你是否还能设法返回。

entries.source: The rift is too unstable to cross it.
entries.target: 裂隙太不稳定而无法穿越。

entries.source: Claws and teeth. Ice and death. Dragons are not all extinct it seems...
entries.target: 尖牙利齿，冰冷致命。似乎龙族并没有完全灭绝……
并将其喂给幼龙们分食

entries.source: I have heard there is a dragon hunter in the Daikara that is unhappy about the wyrm being already dead.
entries.target: 我听说有一名弑龙者来到了岱卡拉，他对于这里栖息的巨龙已经被干掉这件事沮丧不已。

entries.source: Claws and teeth. Fire and death. Dragons are not all extinct it seems...
entries.target: 尖牙利齿，火焰致命。似乎龙族并没有灭绝……

entries.source: A huge and heavily-scarred orc with a gigantic sword. His helm is fashioned from a dragon's skull.
entries.target: 一个手持巨剑的高大兽人，浑身伤疤。他的头盔由龙的头骨制成。

entries.source: A paper scrap, left by an adventurer.
entries.target: 由冒险者留下的碎纸片。

entries.source:
As you walk toward the Daikara you can not fail to notice the huge volcano that erupts in the center of it, right where the path is taking you.
You see pyroclasts ejected from the heart of the volcano, they look relatively harmless but very impressive.
entries.target:
当你走向岱卡拉时，你不可能注意不到岱卡拉中心的巨大火山正在喷发，那正是小路通向的地方。
你看到火山口喷出火山碎屑，看起来相对无害，却令人印象深刻。

entries.source: The Iron Council (Dwarven empire main city)
entries.target: 钢铁议会（矮人帝国的主城）
